page.overview:
What is Hydreigon?

Hydreigon is the supporting character in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Gates to Infinity. He is the Voice of Life, the embodiement of the world's life, who has taken on the physical form of a Pokémon.​

Despite his appearance, Hydreigon is a friendly and polite individual. Being the embodiment of the world's will, he strives to protect it any way he can.

During the Player's dream before dropping to the Pokémon world, a voice called for help to save the Pokémon world. Then a vision is seen, with Munna being chased by Hydreigon. Shortly after the expedition to the Great Glacier, Munna appears in the Player's dream, telling the Player that Hydreigon is the pure destruction in Pokémon form, as he would devour anything before him, causing the world's balance to be disrupted, thus leading Munna to call the player character from the human world. She leads the player character to go to the base of Mt. Kilionia to "rescue her".

However, this was all a trick for Munna to ambush the Player, and Munna's gang starts hunting the Player and their Partner, causing them to split up during the chase. At the end of Daybreak Ridge, when the Player is outnumbered by the power of Munna's gang, Hydreigon himself appears and rescue's the Player
